scope: causal communication learnability test for message-conditioned receiver actions
principles: pair each normal rollout with the same sender message withheld at the certified handoff turn
center normal-minus-dropped verified terminal-return effects across eight receiver replicas
train only the normal receiver ACT span; never train on intervention tokens
cover both latent worlds of pairs 7 and 9 in every update and alternate receiver policy slots
add no message, action, target, capture, or communication reward
retain matched decoys exclusively as an online specificity control
primary_success_measure: critical normal-minus-dropped receiver target-action and terminal-return lift
checkpoint_selection: development-only after update 30; intermediate pulses are diagnostic
frozen_policy: the existing frozen OOD evaluation remains byte-identical and unopened until development selection
limitation: success establishes communication-conditioned learnability on two training pairs, not broad swarm intelligence
